Name: Krobus valley
Author: NewCapAm
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
replaces villiagers with Krobus-y Shadow creatures who are silent on fridays out of respect for yoba and all love void mayonaise (all other liked and loved gifts are the same). Some of the monsters in the mine are replaced by villiagers 🤭 (haven't done all of them yet, working on it).
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
You need the content patcher mod. 
And i'd reccomend a mod that darkens the valley (to set the krobus mood), i haven't made any darkening mods but there should be a few to chose from.
